name: Soft Gradient SaaS
tagline: Pastel blobs, glass cards and springy pop-ins for a friendly product launch.
description: Warm, approachable launch video for consumer and SMB software. Slow drifting pastel blobs behind blurred-in headlines, a frosted product card whose rows check off one by one, and floating benefit pills.
textAnimations: gradient text on the payoff line

rhythm.notes: Ambient blob drift spans the whole video; foreground beats every ~0.25s.

guide:
- Three blurred blobs (filter: blur(90px)) drift for the full duration with sine.inOut — never stop the background.
- Headlines: two lines, the second in a #7c5cff → #ff7ab6 gradient (background-clip:text). Enter with y 50 + blur 12px, 0.8s power3.out, 0.3s apart.
- Product UI goes in frosted cards: white 72% + 36px radius + soft purple shadow. Rows reveal with 0.22s stagger and gradient check circles that pop with back.out(3).
- Benefit pills float in with back.out(2) and bob gently (y -12, yoyo).
- End on the product name + a dark pill CTA with the real URL.
